blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Families visiting cemeteries for Kalag-Kalag 2026 must leave firearms and other weapons, sound systems, and alcoholic drinks outside. Mayor Nestor Archival urged the public to observe the occasion peacefully. In an interview on Thursday, October 29, Archival said the restrictions aim to prevent disturbances and allow families to pray, offer prayers […]...
